# San Jose City Council -- June 9, 2026

## Consent Calendar

The Council met today. The Council approved a $250,000 increase to its contract with CSG Advisors, seconded by Councilmember Rosemary Kamei (Item 2.8).

Full agenda and minutes are available from the City Clerk.
